facility.name: Nina Peterson
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Field Trips

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two children enrolled did not have immunization records maintained in their file.
Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Two children did not have emergency medical authorization/consent on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: Three children did not have any release contact information on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §747.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Parents' Phone Numbers: One child did not have parent contact information on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Parents' Phone Numbers (26 TAC §747.605(5))

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: The fire extinguisher was not mounted properly and was sitting on a shelf.
Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The childcare home does not have a non-absorbent pad for diaper changes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §747.3303(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Age-appropriate: The home is not equipped with equipment that allows children the opportunities for thinking and sensory development, small and large muscle development, language development, social and emotional development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Age-appropriate (26 TAC §747.2405(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location: The emergency evacuation and relocation diagram do not show the relocation area outside of the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location (26 TAC §747.5007(3))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuate and Relocate with Essential Documentation: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how parent contact information, authorizations for emergency medical care and how daily attendance logs will be evacuated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuate and Relocate with Essential Documentation (26 TAC §747.5003(3))

occurrences.finding: Must Have at Least One 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or Fire Extinguisher Approved by Fire Marshal: The childcare home is not equipped with the correct size fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Must Have at Least One 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or Fire Extinguisher Approved by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §747.5103)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Communication Procedures: The Emergency Preparedness Plan does not state how you will communicate with local emergency authorities and Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Communication Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(2))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Complete Kit: The First Aid Kit lacked disposable gloves and a thermometer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Complete Kit (26 TAC §747.3803(a))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: The Emergency Preparedness Plan lacked the following information:  1. How children under will be evacuated.  2, A copy of the evacuation and relocation diagram  3. The caregivers responsibility in a shelter in place/lock down emergency  4. Name and address of an alternate shelter  5. How the children will be accounted for
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational polices lacked the following informality  1. Promotion of indoor and outdoor activity  2. Parent's rights  3. Instructions for parents to review Minimum Standards on line, the phone number for the Abuse and Neglect Hotline and the HHSC website.  4. Emergency Preparedness Plan
Smoke-Detection System: A working smoke detector has not been installed in the areas that will be used by children.
Emergency Preparedness- Reunification Plan: The Emergency Preparedness Plan does not state how children will be reunited with their parent once the emergency is over,

Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Age-appropriate: The home is not equipped with equipment that allows children the opportunities for thinking and sensory development, small and large muscle development, language development, social and emotional development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Age-appropriate (26 TAC §747.2505(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness-Continuity of Care: The Emergency Preparedness Plan does not state how children will be cared for during the emergency.
